dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and '8' shaped rings exhibit sharp, light-colored perimeters that transition abruptly into darker brownish-grey fur; specifically, a large double-annular structure is located mid-flank and several smaller circular shapes are visible along the upper dorsal line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid white, high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily localized on the neck area and scattered as small specks between larger annular structures on the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the mid-body '8' shaped structure, the prominent posterior 'O' ring, and the dorsal 'C' shaped mark form a distinct scalene triangle relative to the longitudinal axis of the torso.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A highly visible, straight linear white mark (scar) is located on the central flank. Dark reddish-brown pixel clusters indicative of physical trauma are visible at the base and trailing edge of the posterior flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark, high-contrast linear structures corresponding to the claw-tips are visible on the forward pectoral flipper.
